title: Protecting Austin Water & Green Space
summary:
*   City leaders discussed potential legal action concerning Austin's water rights and rates.
*   Discussions were held regarding acquiring land for open space and preservation in the Upper Bull Creek Watershed.
*   The special meeting consisted entirely of an executive session for legal and land acquisition advice, with no public votes or immediate policy decisions made.
